title: Find Substring With Given Hash Value
goal: Find the earliest length-k substring with the requested polynomial hash.
strategy: The first character has exponent zero, so slide from right to left. Multiply the previous hash by power, add the new first letter, and remove the outgoing letter contribution at exponent k.
